  > 1. **Adopted.** Gap now reads "in the sources we reviewed"; no "first to ask" in abstract/contributions; novelty rests on the four checkable elements (§2).
  > 2. **Adopted.** M5 is two fits: φ-error vs m (slope −1/2, estimator check) and m*(target) vs exact margin g and d (σ²/g² expected, checked not assumed).
  > 3. **Adopted.** §3a defines the unit (model evaluations incl. background; permutation 2d·B per antithetic pair); equal-evaluations primary, equal-m secondary; also for R1.
  > 4. **Adopted.** Paired comparisons on the same instances/references, floors a/b/c on the same subset; `analysis` to report the smallest resolvable effect per claim; "not resolved" added as a label.
  > 5. **Adopted.** R1 criterion fixed: Brier of P(top-k correct), held-out instances/models, paired bootstrap CI entirely below 0, 0.01 as the smallest useful difference; AUROC/curve secondary.
  > 6. **Adopted.** B ∈ {20, 50, 200} + k-means background on German Credit and ACS-Employment is required, last in the cut order; instances = random test sample with fixed seed.
  > 7. **Adopted.** New body Table 2 (guidance): minimum budget per d × margin bin where P_c^ε ≥ 0.9 holds for ≥ 90% of instances, with CI and scope; "not reached" allowed.
  > 8. **Adopted.** Renumbered: body = Fig 1–5, Tables 1–3 (certificate is Table 3/Fig 6, shortened if negative); appendix A1/A2.
  > 9. **Adopted.** (a) `l1_reg` named in M1; (b) aggregate metrics = mean Pearson / relative L2, "high" ≥ 0.9 as a stated guess with sensitivity; (c) AUC in Table 1.
